q: Which project layer should generally preserve source extracts unchanged?
why: Preserving raw input supports traceability and reproducibility.

q: A reproducible notebook should be checked by:
options: Restarting the kernel and running all cells in order
why: This reveals hidden state and stale outputs.

options: A recorded snapshot/change set in version history
why: A commit records a coherent set of changes.

q: A private repository automatically makes patient data safe to upload:
why: Privacy settings do not establish governance or security approval.

options: Definitions, inputs, code, QA, limitations and next actions
why: A handoff should let an authorized colleague inspect and continue the work.
